name: WorkBuddy积分助手
description_zh: WorkBuddy积分助手：读取本机已登录态，接口直查 Buddy 加油站数据，生成每日积分播报；支持成长计划只读展示、派猫猫旅行只读展示与全自动闭环（先领后派），以及一键自动签到（幂等安全）；另支持把每日播报推送至用户自有消息渠道（钉钉/飞书/企业微信/微信/邮件/短信/Slack/Telegram/Bark/通用Webhook/系统通知，默认复用消息推送技能 config.json，--no-push 可关），凭据只存本地、绝不外传。以只读为主；写操作仅限签到与旅行派出/领取，且旅行需显式加 --travel-auto 才执行；不打印 token，不修改登录态。
description_en: WorkBuddy Credit Assistant reads the local login state and queries Buddy Station data via API to produce a daily credit report (balance, streak, activity calendar, weekly progress, current event, streak rewards). It also shows the read-only growth plan and Buddy travel status (location, countdown, claimable credits), and supports one-click idempotent auto check-in plus a fully automated Buddy travel loop (claim first, then depart, only with an explicit --travel-auto flag). It can also push the daily report to the user's own messaging channels (DingTalk/Feishu/WeCom/WeChat/PushPlus/Email/SMS/Slack/Telegram/Bark/Generic Webhook/System, reusing the message-push skill config by default, disabled with --no-push). Read-only by default; write calls are limited to check-in and travel claim/depart, and never print the token.
